dysonprotocol.nft.v1beta1.QueryClassRequ.title: Query Class Request
dysonprotocol.nft.v1beta1.QueryClassRequ.description: QueryClassRequest is the request type for the Query/Class RPC method

class.description: class defines the class of the nft type.

dysonprotocol.nft.v1beta1.QueryClassResp.title: Query Class Response
dysonprotocol.nft.v1beta1.QueryClassResp.description: QueryClassResponse is the response type for the Query/Class RPC method

id.description: id defines the unique identifier of the NFT classification, similar to the contract address of ERC721

name.description: name defines the human-readable name of the NFT classification. Optional

symbol.description: symbol is an abbreviated name for nft classification. Optional

description.description: description is a brief description of nft classification. Optional

uri.description: uri for the class metadata stored off chain. It can define schema for Class and NFT `Data` attributes. Optional

uri_hash.description: uri_hash is a hash of the document pointed by uri. Optional

type_url.description: The type url prefixed with a slash, like '/cosmos.bank.v1beta1.MsgSend'

value.description: Must be a valid serialized protocol buffer of the above specified type.

data.description: data is the app specific metadata of the NFT class. Optional

dysonprotocol.nft.v1beta1.Class.title: Class
dysonprotocol.nft.v1beta1.Class.description: Class defines the class of the nft type. Whaleswap notes: - Auction escrows may be represented by NFTs whose (class_id, id) pair is   referenced by auction records. Query endpoints such as AuctionByNFT use   this identity to locate the escrow state.
